content.thinking: The $44.99 AP gap traces to invoice 742's $45 shortfall offset by a $0.01 overpayment, plus duplicate invoices 801/802 inflating AP; reversal 2464 (reversing 2416) looks legitimate since it's dated the first day of period 5, so I'll exclude it as a finding. I'll submit the findings now.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO",h."PRD_ID",h."POST_DT",p."END_DT",p."CLOSE_DT",p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Manual GL journals 2462 (period 4, posted 20240525) and 2463 (period 7, posted 20240808) were posted after the CLOSE_DT of their closed periods; 2462 is also dated outside period 4's date range (late May).

Invoices 801 and 802 duplicate invoices 557 and 28 (same vendor, same invoice number once whitespace is trimmed, same amount and date). Each duplicate was also posted to the GL again (journals 2460 and 2461), overstating AP and expense.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID",i."INV_AMT",i."JRNL_NO",l."CR_AMT" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID"=742 and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' and l."CR_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 742 has INV_AMT 13307.11 but its journal 2215 records 13352.11 to AP Control, a 45.00 difference.

findings.evidence_sql: select p."PAY_ID",p."INV_ID",p."PAY_AMT",i."INV_AMT" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Payment 52 pays 7122.95 against invoice 78 whose amount is 7122.94 (0.01 overpayment, also reflected in payment journal 1129).
